acceptanceCriteria: Go struct fields are indexed as declarations with their file and line
A task naming a struct field retrieves the defining file, verified on the V1-1015 case
Frozen context evaluation shows no recall regression
body: context-1021d (PR #1439, TCP-V0-152(c)) now discloses identifiers with no indexed declaration, such as the struct field ExpectedTests, as unresolved, but types.go is still not retrieved because fields are not indexed as definitions. Indexing fields would turn the disclosure into recall.
title: Context index does not record struct fields as declarations, so field-named tasks cannot retrieve the defining file (V1-1015 follow-up)
